description: React component for managing and displaying user's books, including fetches from API endpoints, toggling between list and shelf views, and rendering UI elements like Navbar, BookList, ShelfView, and ShelfModal.

classes.name: MyBooks
classes.description: React class component managing the user's book collections with state, lifecycle, and rendering logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches book data and sets up resize listener.

methods.name: getReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books marked as read from API.

methods.name: getDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Fetches books not finished from API.

methods.name: toReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books marked to read from API.

methods.name: readingBooks
methods.description: Fetches books currently being read from API.

methods.name: trackCurrentDeviceSize
methods.description: Sets up window resize listener to toggle list view based on screen width.

methods.name: onToggleListView
methods.description: Toggles between list and shelf view modes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the overall layout, navigation, book lists, shelf modal, and toggle switches.
